text: The open sets of a topological space form a complete Heyting algebra, where A→B is interpreted as:
choices: the interior of (X\A)∪B (the largest open set U with U∩A⊆B)
explanation: In the Heyting algebra of open sets: A→B = int((X∖A)∪B) = the largest open U such that U∩A ⊆ B. Negation ¬A = int(X∖A) = interior of the complement.
